machine=avocado-fr202
initramfs_file=avocado-image-initramfs-avocado-fr202.cpio.zst
kernel_file=Image

stderr=serial,vidconsole
stdin=serial,usbkbd
stdout=serial,vidconsole
serial#=1000000088c98f3b

fdt_addr=2eff2000
fdt_addr_r=0x02600000
fdt_high=ffffffffffffffff

initrd_high=ffffffffffffffff
kernel_addr_r=0x00080000
ramdisk_addr_r=0x02700000

devtype=mmc
devnum=0
bootpart=1
rootdev=/dev/mmcblk0p3

load_image=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${kernel_addr_r} ${kernel_file}
load_initramfs=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${ramdisk_addr_r} ${initramfs_file}
avocado_boot=booti ${kernel_addr_r} ${ramdisk_addr_r}:${filesize} ${fdt_addr};

bootcmd=run load_image load_initramfs avocado_boot
